title: Retract a reviewed negative
description: Withdraws a reviewed negative by naming its exact current revision heads and stages a retraction in a Draft Proposal. The Notebook history remains in the FieldWorks project, and only Apply records the withdrawal.
usage: Usage: motif parsimony negative retract --project <fwdata> --draft <name> --intent '<closed retraction JSON>' --confirm "I confirm this reviewed negative should be withdrawn." [--json]
